name: Underworld / Mafia Dark Romance
description: High-stakes, protective female syndicate boss, vulnerable male lead, intense emotional twists, underworld clashes.
tone: intense, dramatic, protective, thrilling, romantic suspense
target_audience: Urban web-novel, mafia romance, TikTok short anime fiction
visual_style: Dark anime aesthetic, cinematic lighting, sleek suits, rainy neon cities, grand subterranean auctions, luxury sports cars

character_archetypes.protagonist: Lethal, untouchable female crime syndicate lord, secretly yearning for a childhood savior
character_archetypes.deuteragonist: Vulnerable, trapped or betrayed young male student with a sacred keepsake (ring/pendant)
character_archetypes.antagonist: Corrupt underworld brokers or treacherous family members

narrative_formula: Hook (0:00-0:15): Establish extreme power disparity and a lingering memory/vow.
Inciting Incident: The male lead is in grave danger or auctioned off.
Rising Action & Execution: Female lead recognizes him, ruthless retaliation against captors.
Climax Encounter: Rescue with emotional confusion; he does not recognize his savior.
Finished Resolution / Cliffhanger: High-fever delirium or startling revelation that concludes the arc with high emotional payoff.
